# Ownerdeck

> An AI assistant that answers a business's customers on the business's own
> WhatsApp number — in about two seconds, at any hour, in the customer's
> language — quoting the owner's real prices and live availability, then
> capturing the booking and notifying the owner.

Ownerdeck is run by Mark Saade, a sole trader based in Cyprus, and sold to
owner-operated businesses anywhere. It is not a self-serve platform: each
assistant is configured personally for the customer.

## What it is

- Runs on the business's existing WhatsApp Business number. No new number,
  nothing for the end customer to install.
- Replies in about two seconds, day or night.
- Detects the customer's language and answers in it — English, Russian,
  Greek, German, Polish, Arabic, Hebrew and others — including mid-conversation
  switches.
- Reads live availability and prices from the systems the owner already uses,
  so it does not invent a rate or promise something unavailable.
- Calculates the full quote: days × rate, delivery, extras such as insurance.
- Captures the booking with dates, times, pickup/drop-off, name and contact,
  and confirms it with a reference number.
- Notifies the owner the moment a booking lands, and writes every conversation
  to a log the owner can read.
- The owner can take over any conversation at any time.

## What it does not do

It does not take payment, handle complaints or accidents, manage contracts or
fleets, or replace a member of staff.

## Who it suits

Any owner-run business with availability, a price and a booking: car, buggy
and quad rental, boat charters, airport transfers, villa changeovers, salons,
clinics. Currently live with a car rental company.

## Price

EUR 150 per month. No VAT is charged — Ownerdeck is not VAT registered, so
EUR 150 is the full amount. Setup fee waived for early customers. No minimum
term, no notice period, cancel by email. Live in 48 hours.

## Transparency

The assistant identifies itself as an AI and not a person, on this website and
on customers' own numbers, per EU AI Act Article 50.
